title: Grateful Dead Live at Silva Hall, Hult Center on 1983-08-29
lineage: Sony TC-D5M (original record deck)>Pre Sonus Inspire GT>Sound Forge>.wav files>Trader's Little Helper>flac files
source: Source: 2 Sennheiser 421 microphones > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes;

ai_review.summary: Decent audience tape captures a fast‑pacing 1983 show that shines on The Other One but suffers from rushed Eyes and Estimated.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (aud) source that most listeners find listenable and fairly clear, though not pristine. Musically the concert feels overly hurried for some fans – especially on Eyes and Estimated – while The Other One receives praise as a highlight.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (≈3.3) with mixed comments: recording is acceptable, but the performance is criticized for being too fast, lowering the overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the tape as 'pretty good' and 'OK‑listenable', indicating decent clarity but no high‑fidelity soundboard quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is perceived as rushed; tempo often exceeds the band's comfort level, leading to uneven pacing despite a few strong moments.
